en.headline: HSBC completes US$1 billion share buyback programme
en.dek: The bank said a final Hong Kong purchase of 911,200 shares on Monday brought the programme announced on 5 August to a close.
body: HSBC Holdings said it has completed the US$1 billion share buyback it announced on 5 August, after a final purchase of shares in Hong Kong on Monday.

In a filing to the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, the bank said it bought 911,200 ordinary shares from BNP Paribas Financial Markets on 28 September for cancellation. Prices paid ranged from HK$158.00 to HK$160.70, with a volume-weighted average of HK$159.5951.

Across the programme, HSBC bought 31,735,502 shares in the United Kingdom at a volume-weighted average of £15.1909 and 16,921,600 shares in Hong Kong at HK$161.2887, all for cancellation, for a total consideration of about US$1 billion. After the latest purchase the company said it had 17,141,942,291 ordinary shares in issue.

zh.headline: 滙控完成十億美元股份回購計劃
zh.dek: 滙豐控股公布周一在港再購入91.12萬股註銷後，8月5日宣布的十億美元回購已完成。
body: 滙豐控股宣布，8月5日公布的十億美元股份回購計劃已經完成。
向香港交易所提交的公告顯示，公司於9月28日向法國巴黎銀行購入91.12萬股每股面值0.50美元普通股作註銷，每股作價介乎158元至160.70元，成交量加權平均價為159.5951元。
自回購開始，集團按成交量加權平均價每股15.1909英鎊在英國地點回購3173.5502萬股，並以每股161.2887港元在港交所回購1692.16萬股，全部作註銷，總代價約十億美元。完成今次購買後，已發行普通股為171億4194萬2291股。
